title: 🚨 SOMEONE IN YOUR CHURCH IS HURTING—AND YOUR FIRST ANSWER COULD HELP THEM HEAL… OR MAKE THEM SHUT DOWN.
paragraphs: 🚨 SOMEONE IN YOUR CHURCH IS HURTING—AND YOUR FIRST ANSWER COULD HELP THEM HEAL… OR MAKE THEM SHUT DOWN.
They finally trusted you enough to talk.
Their marriage is breaking.
They’re trapped in a recurring sin.
They’re battling anger, fear, grief, addiction, temptation, unforgiveness, or spiritual confusion.
Then they ask:
“What should I do?”
What happens next matters.
Because biblical counseling is more than finding a verse that sounds relevant.
It requires listening.
Wisdom.
Compassion.
Truth.
Discernment.
And above all—pointing people to Jesus Christ.

HOW TO COUNSEL CHURCH MEMBERS BIBLICALLY
A Practical Guide to Listening, Speaking Truth, Applying Scripture, and Pointing People to Christ
This book was created for pastors, ministry leaders, small-group leaders, mentors, disciplers—and believers who regularly find themselves saying:
“Lord, help me know what to say.”
🔥 WHY THIS BOOK MATTERS
You can have good intentions and still give poor counsel.
You can quote Scripture and still apply it carelessly.
You can tell someone the truth and still fail to speak it in love.
And you can become so focused on fixing someone's immediate problem that you forget the greater goal:
Christlike transformation.
Biblical counsel doesn't make people dependent on the counselor.
It teaches people to depend on Christ.
Inside this practical biblical guide, you'll discover:

• How to listen before you speak
• How to ask questions that uncover deeper heart struggles
• How to distinguish biblical truth from personal opinion
• How to apply Scripture faithfully instead of throwing verses at problems
• How to confront sin with both truth and grace
• How to encourage confession, repentance, forgiveness, and restoration
• How to help someone move from conviction into practical obedience
• How to establish healthy accountability and counseling boundaries
• How to handle confidentiality wisely
• How to recognize when a situation requires qualified professional, medical, safeguarding, legal, or emergency help
• How to walk patiently with believers through long-term battles
• How to keep Jesus Christ—not yourself—at the center of counseling
Galatians 6:2 tells us:
“Carry each other’s burdens, and in this way you will fulfill the law of Christ.”
⚔️ MOST PEOPLE GIVE ADVICE. FEW LEARN TO GIVE BIBLICAL COUNSEL.
Most people want to say something.
Few learn when to listen.
Most people want to fix the problem.
Few look deeper at the heart.
Most people can offer an opinion.
Few are prepared to open God's Word faithfully.
Most want people to leave feeling better.
Biblical discipleship desires something deeper: that people leave knowing Christ better and learning to obey Him.
The question isn't simply:
“Do people come to you for advice?”
The question is:
“Are you prepared to point them toward Christ when they do?”
Keep teaching.
Keep publishing.
Keep pointing people to Christ.
We're building a Gospel Warrior movement of believers who want to know the Word, live the Word, disciple others, and spread the Gospel.
⚔️ IF THAT'S THE KIND OF BELIEVER YOU WANT TO BE—JOIN US.
Then do three things:

Listen carefully.
Understand humbly.
Open Scripture faithfully.
Speak truth lovingly.
Point people continually to CHRIST.

⚔️ GOSPEL WARRIOR
Biblical Truth. Real People. Lasting Change.
